project: GTI Club: Côte d'Azur for Wii
approach: Konami PowerPC 403, SHARC DSP and 68000 sound programs statically translated to C; the 3D board and sound chips recreated on the Wii
notes: Runs natively on a real Wii, launched with the Homebrew Channel. Sideways Wii Remote with tilt steering, Classic Controller and GameCube controller; rumble; 480p.
